name: GameDay
author: DarylE (derwin12)
description: Trigger FPP light sequences when your NFL, NHL, MLB, AFL or NCAA team scores or wins — live game tracking via ESPN.

privacy.summary: Asks ESPN's public score API about the teams you pick, and loads their logos in your browser. Keeps nothing but your own settings.

sends.what: the league, team and game IDs you chose to track
sends.why: to look up your team's schedule and live score

sends.what: your browser's address, when a plugin page shows a team logo
sends.why: to display the team logo on the setup and status pages

systemChanges.what: adds a.espncdn.com and site.api.espn.com to FPP's Apache Content-Security-Policy so logos and score lookups load
